mods.hero1_p: The FURY MPST Pulse range puts three processes and pulse MIG in one machine, from standard 10A power supply.
mods.hero2_p: Respirator welding helmets with powered air for all-day welding and grinding.
mods.hero3_p: Downdraft tables, mobile extractors and personal fume monitors for the new exposure limits.
